providers.pinScope: Observed reference CLI version; installation provenance and binary digest remain unverified. Not an enforced legacy admission pin.
providers.capability: Existing supervised Codex CLI execution and comparison fallback
providers.boundary: Roost owns task, authority, queue and audit. Worker owns lease, process and repository guards. Provider owns transient inference only.
providers.updateRollback: Explicit private installation update; retain previous binary/config; rerun compatibility and Worker regressions before adoption.
providers.healthReadiness: Existing protocol and execution gates remain required. Reference availability does not establish Hermes or pilot readiness.
providers.resourceCost: One local CLI process plus model usage; duration enforced by Worker. Hard output-token enforcement remains unavailable.
providers.failureMode: Existing stop/reconciliation path; no automatic alternate provider or retry outside the Roost queue.

providers.pinScope: Official source commit and package version; no installed binary or environment attestation yet.
providers.capability: Future Codex-backed inference through Hermes and bounded Roost MCP/API
providers.boundary: No independent task, memory, kanban, schedule, delegation or session authority. No Roost credentials in provider/model environment; no direct database or arbitrary filesystem access.
providers.updateRollback: No automatic install/update. Private pinned environment, retained prior environment/config, license/dependency review and repeated compatibility PoC for every pin change.
providers.healthReadiness: Native Windows support is an upstream claim. Identity, installation, MCP isolation, provider model compatibility and budget/stop/recovery behavior require private proof. Always blocked in contract v1.
providers.resourceCost: Python >=3.11,<3.14 plus dependencies, local provider process and model usage. Disk, memory, latency and token overhead unmeasured; measure in read-only PoC before any pilot.
providers.failureMode: Expected not-ready state without incidents, installation, claim, process start or automatic fallback. Worker/API fail closed.
